# brig sandbox delete

Delete a sandbox and its /sandbox

## Synopsis

```text
brig sandbox delete [VM] SANDBOX
```

Also: `brig sandbox rm`.

## Description

Delete a sandbox, as openshell sandbox delete does, with what is in its
/sandbox. On a terminal, delete asks first; --yes skips the question. Without
a terminal on standard input, as in a script, it deletes without asking, as
[`brig delete`](brig-delete.md) does.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-w, --workspace string` | the workspace of the gateway to work in (default: $BRIG\_WORKSPACE, else default) |
| `-y, --yes` | do not ask for confirmation |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
